steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to EspoCRM with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type the password text exactly as {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}). Then confirm you are signed in and report what page you land on.

02-find: Navigate to the Opportunities list (EspoCRM). Find every opportunity whose Name starts with 'Seed:'. Report the exact full names of all of them, exactly as shown on the page, one per line. Do not modify anything.

03-create: In EspoCRM, create a new Opportunity with these exact values: Name = '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity'; Account = the account named exactly 'Bench Account' (it is a link field — you must actually select the record 'Bench Account' from the suggestions or the select dialog, not just type it; other accounts have similar names, so pick the exact one); Stage = 'Negotiation'; Amount = 12500; Close Date = 2026-12-31; Assigned User = the user named exactly 'Bench Assignee' (also a link field — actually select the user record 'Bench Assignee', not merely type it); Description = 'Bench opportunity for run {{runid}}'. Save the record. Then open the created opportunity's own page and report: its Name, the Account shown, the Stage, the Amount, the Close Date, the Assigned User, the Description, and the record ID from the page address (the URL looks like #Opportunity/view/<id>).

04-edit: The edit form for the opportunity '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity' is currently open. Read the Close Date field's exact value (it should be 2026-12-31) and report it exactly as shown, including the year. Also report the exact value in the Amount field and the currency symbol shown. Then cancel/close the edit form WITHOUT saving any changes, so we return to the record's detail view. Report what the detail view shows after cancelling.

05-find: On the record page of the opportunity '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity' (URL #Opportunity/view/{{03-create.url.h2}}), find the Stream panel and post a new note whose text is 'Bench stream post for run {{runid}}'. Submit the post so it appears in the Stream. Then report the exact text of the post as it now appears in the Stream panel, and confirm it is visible on the page.

06-open: Open the opportunity record page at #Opportunity/view/{{03-create.url.h2}} in EspoCRM and verify, reading only (no edits): (a) the record's Name, (b) the Account link value, (c) the Stage, (d) the Amount with its currency, (e) the Assigned User, (f) the Description, (g) that the Stream panel contains a post whose text includes '{{runid}}' and quote that post's exact text, and (h) the record ID shown in the browser address. Report each of these exactly as displayed.
